newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX looking into Yamaichi allegations - TV.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX looking into Yamaichi allegations - TV.

text.p: The Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) is looking into alleged illegal futures trading by Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd, the state-owned Television Corp of Singapore (TCS) said on Wednesday.
It said the investigation followed reports from Japan that payments which prosecutors believe Yamaichi made to a corporate racketeer came from profits in stock index futures trading in SIMEX.
SIMEX gave no further details on the investigation, TCS said.
TCS quoted Yamaichi's Singapore operation as saying it had spoken with SIMEX on Wednesday on its own initiative, but had not been in further contact with them on Thursday.

Japanese prosecutors raided Yamaichi offices in Tokyo on Wednesday and the homes of top executives on Thursday, in search of evidence of suspected illegal deals with a racketeer at the heart of a huge scandal that already ensnared Nomura Securities Co Ltd and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd.
SIMEX and Yamaichi Singapore officials could not be reached immediately for comment on the TCS report.
